summary: Iteration 25: Full backend + frontend verification of (a) student profile with order linkage (paid_amount, order_id, order_status, payment_method), (b) student delete that KEEPS orders/invoices but removes enrollments/group_enrollments/progress/sessions/certificates/consulting_bookings, (c) manual group enrollment endpoints, (d) Payments page kart/havale separation (filter buttons + revenue cards + badges). Backend: 6/6 pytest passed in test_iteration25.py. Frontend: Playwright flow executed end-to-end against public URL — admin logged in, /yonetim/odemeler stat-card-revenue + stat-transfer-revenue visible (card: 0 orders / 0₺, transfer: 7 orders / 19.004₺ – PayTR is mocked, so 0 card orders is expected). payment-method-all/card/transfer filter buttons all present; selecting 'transfer' shows 8 rows all with badge 'Havale/EFT', selecting 'card' shows 0 rows (consistent with no card orders in db), 'all' shows 9 rows. approve-transfer-* button visible for pending transfers. /yonetim/ogrenciler row delete-student-* button visible; opening profile via manage-student-* renders student-groups-section + enroll-group-select + manual-group-enroll + delete-student-btn; dropdown exposed 1 group option, manual enrollment succeeded (toast 'Grup eğitimine eklendi', Ücretsiz + Manuel Kayıt badges rendered); remove-group-* removed it; delete-student-btn closed modal and student disappeared from list.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_student in routes_admin.py correctly keeps db.orders and db.notifications; also removes password_resets and consulting_bookings. Verified via test (order remains in /admin/payments after student delete).
student_detail returns paid_amount==0 and order_id==None for manual group enrollments (ge.order_id is None path), which the UI renders as 'Ücretsiz' + 'Manuel Kayıt' — correct.

In student_detail, groups fallback query (line 325) uses {user_id, group_id, status: paid|awaiting_transfer}; items[].group_id lookup via _linked_order already covers purchase orders. Fallback matches orders with top-level group_id field (legacy orders) — kept for compat.

mark_paid branches: kind=='group' creates group_enrollments; else path iterates order['items'] and handles both course_id and group_id (via enroll_group_item). Cart checkout for groups uses this else branch and works correctly (verified).
AdminPayments.jsx methodOf(o) classifies 'paytr' as card, 'transfer' as transfer, else 'free'. Correct for current payment methods.
AdminStudents.jsx delete flow uses window.confirm — Playwright page.on('dialog') accepts it as expected per the agent-to-agent note.
No regression: group checkout via cart items[{group_id}] correctly enrolls after mark-paid and profile reflects paid_amount matching order total.
seed_data_creation: During tests: 2 guest-checkout users (test_iter25_c_*, test_iter25_g_*) with transfer orders for course_8b53eae5576a and grp_741a4764d948, 1 manual-enroll user (test_iter25_m_*), 1 UI test user (test_iter25_ui_*) + 1 UI order (test_iter25_ord_*). All TEST_ users deleted. Per requirements, 5 TEST_-era orders remain in db.orders for accounting (expected behavior).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayTR card payments remain MOCKED/unavailable (503). Kart Geliri card shows 0₺/0 orders which is correct given no real card orders exist. If future iteration adds mock card orders, re-verify card filter shows them with 'Kredi Kartı' badge. The 5 orphan TEST_ orders left in db.orders are intentional (keep-for-accounting requirement) and may be purged manually from Mongo if desired; they still render on /yonetim/odemeler Payments list.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
